title: Freeze Immunity
wikitext_excerpt:
{{AttributeInfobox |image1 = Freeze.png |type = Immunity |variants = Regular
{{Boss}}[[Boss]] |immunities = Regular: *{{Freeze|Freeze}}Freeze *{{Freeze|Chillness}}Chillness *{{Freeze|Freeze Defense Dropping}}Freeze Defense Dropping *[[File:SledgerLevel2.png|20px|Sledger Ice Breaker]][[Sledger]] Ice Breaker {{Boss}}[[Boss]]: *{{Freeze|Freeze}}Freeze *{{Freeze|Partial Chillness}}Partial Chillness Towers & Units: *{{Freeze|Enemy Freeze}}Enemy Freeze |sandbox = No |tag = {{AttrTag|Second|Freeze.png|No Freeze}} }} ==Description== '''Freeze Immunity''' (with its tag referring to it as "''No Freeze''") is an immunity that prevents the enemy from being frozen and chilled. For towers and units, it prevents them from being frozen. ==Mechanics== '''Freeze Immunity''' makes it so that the enemy cannot be frozen. Additionally, it stops the enemy from being chilled by them. Because of its chillness immunity, it also prevents the enemies from having their defense dropped by freezing towers. Additionally, as the [[Sledger]] deals double damage to frozen or chilled enemies, it cannot deal double damage to them. Larger enemies are also frozen for a shorter amount of time than average sized enemies. The following towers/consumables become unable to apply these freeze based effects to '''Freeze Immune''' enemies: *[[Freezer]] *[[Frost Blaster]] *[[Sledger]] *[[Jester]] *[[Cryomancer]] *[[Snowballer]] *[[Elementalist]] *[[Blizzard Bomb]] *[[Pumpkin Bomb]] *[[Santa's Air Strike]] *[[Ducky Squad]] ([[Ice Ducky]]) '''Freeze Immunity''' is given to all [[Boss]] enemies, though that immunity is different from the regular one. Both version are immune to being frozen, however, it is only partially immune to chillness. It is slowed down less by chillness, but it is not immune to it. This means that bosses can have their defense dropped and can be dealt double damage to by the [[Sledger]], as long as the enemy does not have the regular '''Freeze Immunity'''. '''Freeze Immunity''' also used to prevent enemies from being slowed down from frost mark while it was still in the game. While the [[Freezer]] dealt splash damage, it could not freeze any enemy with [[Splash Damage Immunity]]. However, these enemies could still be frozen by the [[Frost Blaster]] or through its ''Ice Age'' ability. Before the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], there was an additional type of '''Freeze Immunity''', referred to as '''Basic Freeze'''. These enemies could not be frozen by the [[Freezer]]'s main attack, but could be frozen through its ''Ice Drop'' ability. ===Towers=== Certain towers and units also have the '''Freeze Immunity''', which prevents them from being frozen, though it does not prevent them from being targeted. An [[Unstable Ice]] from the [[Operation I.C.E Event]] will still target a freeze immune [[Molten Monster]], even though it not only deals no damage but also does not freeze it. ==Enemy List== The following enemies have '''Freeze Immunity''': *[[Hazmat]] *[[Fallen Hazmat]] *[[Elite Hazmat]] *[[Elite Molten]] *[[Tanker]] *[[Molten Summoner]] *[[Giant Boss]] *[[Summoner Boss]] *[[Speedy King (Legacy)|Speedy King]] (Legacy version) *[[Hazardous]] *[[Amalgamation]] (Modern version) *[[Circuit (Polluted Wasteland II)|Circuit]] (Modern [[Polluted Wasteland II]] version) *[[Abomination]] (Legacy version) *[[Super Toxic]] (Modern version) *[[Necromancer King]] *[[Nuclear Guardian]] *[[Conjurer]] *[[Shotgunner (Pizza Party)|Shotgunner]] *[[Commander (Pizza Party)|Commander]] *[[Cavalry]] (Modern version) *[[Patient Zero]] *[[Awakened Fallen King]] *[[Molten Hazmat]] *[[Blizzard Wizard]] *[[Frost Ravager]] (With shield) *[[Deep Freeze]] *[[Frost Necromancer]] *[[Frost Champion]] *[[Void Reaper]] *[[Mandragora]] *[[Slow King]] (Modern version, with Forcefield) *[[Crystalian]] *[[Void Trickster]] *[[Void Portal]] *[[Void Cultist]] *[[Healing Beacon]] *[[Void Eye]] *[[Void Knight]] *[[Void Guardian]] *[[Golden Mystery]] All [[Boss]] enemies have their own varian

SEE IF YOU CAN BEAT THIS!|Beginning of the Hidden Wave}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The legacy version of the '''Hidden Wave''' was a secret wave that could have been accessed by defeating wave 40 on [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode in 1,009 seconds (16 minutes and 49 seconds) or less. This wave was extremely difficult and spawned unique and powerful enemies. {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} earned remained the same for [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode regardless if the '''Hidden Wave''' was triggered, but losing on the '''Hidden Wave''' only rewarded you with the rewards when losing on wave 40 [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. Triumphing the '''Hidden Wave''' awarded a special {{RLinkB|2124477833|badge}}. Originally, there was no other reward, though after the 9th of June 2023 anyone with the badge is able to claim the [[Glitchy Nametag]] through the [[Gift Box]]. Accessing the wave was quite difficult as you needed to speedrun through [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. This meant that you needed three or more other players to trigger the '''Hidden Wave'''. The '''Hidden Wave''' could not have been triggered on [[MEGA Servers]] through the time requirement (interestingly, the '''Hidden Wave''' could have been triggered on a [[MEGA Servers|MEGA Server]] if the player count was 4 or lower before wave 40 on [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode). Certain maps were favored over others due to cliff space, space near the path entrance, etc. After the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], the wave intro broke. You could still activate it, but the text box did not appear and the game did not acknowledge that the '''Hidden Wave''' had been activated. Additionally, the lighting filter did not change to a red hue with text glitching. The wave would change to 1, while the timer would change to 111111111111111120:00. The only way to know if you have triggered the '''Hidden Wave''' was if the triumph screen did not show after the final wave countdown after you defeated the [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]]. For towers, it fully or partially prevents them from being stunned and targeted by enemies. ==Mechanics== '''Stun Immunity''' makes it so that any enemy with it cannot be stunned/shocked by towers. They will instead be slowed down by 40% for the stun duration. The '''Stun Immunity''' also grants immunity to being knocked back. The following towers/consumables become unable to apply these effects or have them be weakened to '''Stun Immune''' enemies: *[[Electroshocker]] (Shock) *[[Trapper]] (Stun) *[[Warden]] (Shock) *[[DJ Booth]] (Knockback) *[[Tesla]] (Shock) *[[Mercenary Base]] (Knockback) *[[Brawler]] (Knockback) *[[Commando]] (Stun) *[[Archer]] (Shock) *[[Hallow Punk]] (Knockback) *[[Elementalist]] (Knockback) *[[Warlock]] (Knockback) *[[Flash Bang]] (Stun) *[[Ducky Squad]] ([[Shock Ducky]]) All [[Boss]] enemies have this immunity, as part of being a [[Boss]] enemy. The only difference between the two is that the slowdown effect is weaker on [[Boss]] enemies, as it is 20%. If a [[Boss]] enemy also has the [[Stun Immunity]], it will only be slowed down by 10% instead. ===Towers=== '''Stun Immunity''' makes towers unaffected by stuns from enemies and, in multiple cases, also prevents them from being targeted from such attacks. The immunity to being attacked also applies to some enemy attacks which normally would actually affect them, that being freeze and debuffs. Similarly, enemies like the [[Clown]] will avoid applying debuffs to towers with '''Stun Immunity''', even if they can be debuffed. ==Description==
'''Tower Defense Simulator''' ('''TDS'''), is a game created by [[Paradoxum Games]] on the 5th of June 2019, though it was not officially released until the 14th of June 2019. It is a tower defense game where players are tasked with defending the exit from hordes of enemies using towers. It is playable on PC, mobile and consoles.

'''Tower Defense Simulator''' was [[Tower Defense Simulator Award Nominations|nominated for awards]] multiple times in the Bloxies and the Innovation Awards, though it only won the 8th Annual Bloxy Awards in the ''Best Game Trailer'' category.

'''Tower Defense Simulator''' has various social media accounts, including an [https://x.com/paradoxum_games X account], a [https://discord.gg/tds Discord server], [https://www.youtube.com/@ParadoxumGames YouTube channel] and [https://www.reddit.com/r/TDS_Roblox/ Reddit subreddit]. Other accounts also exist, though they are tied to [[Paradoxum Games]] rather than '''Tower Defense Simulator''' specifically, meaning content from [[Paradoxum Games]]' other games also appear there.

==Gameplay==
The main gameplay loop of '''Tower Defense Simulator''' revolves around the players using their [[towers]] and [[consumables]] to defend a map they have chosen from [[enemies]]. Players can pick a limited number of towers and consumables into their loadout. These have varying abilities making them excel in different areas, like some towers being better suited for the early waves or certain towers being used to provide buffs to other towers.

Players can pick a [[Maps|map]] of their choosing in either the main lobby or the intermission lobby. The main lobby allows for picking maps via [[Elevators]], while intermission lobby allows for players to vote on which map they want to play on. In certain modes, like the special maps or [[Challenge Trials]], there is a set map which cannot be changed.

The mode can also be chosen by players. If a map is accessed through the main lobby, there is a vote between the survival modes, while for [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode, no such vote is held due to it only having one. If a map is chosen in the intermission lobby, there is no mode vote as it was already chosen through the [[Matchmaking]] menu by the player.

When a match starts, hordes of enemies will be sent out. Initially, these enemies do not possess any abilities and they will simply walk towards the exit. However, as the match goes on, these enemies will receive various abilities or attributes, such as immunities, abilities to support other enemies and attacks which stun or debuff towers. On the final wave, a major boss will spawn, which the player needs to defeat to triumph the match.

'''Tower Defense Simulator''' also offers [[PVP]], where instead of surviving all the waves, the players are tasked with defeating another player by surviving for longer. [[PVP]] has its own unique mechanics, unique statistics of towers for the mode and consumables that are only usable in [[PVP]] mode.

After beating a match, players are rewarded with various currency, such as {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Exp|}} and {{Gem|Gems}}. These are mainly used to progress through the game, as they allow the player to unlock new areas of the game, purchase items and obtain [[cosmetics]].
